text: You've settled in for the night, remote in hand, just wanting to relax and find something great to watch.
With a quick scroll, your TV instantly presents a perfect list of shows and movies it thinks you'll love. It feels almost magical.
But pause for a moment. How does it *really* know your preferences so well? Is it mind-reading, or some secret crystal ball?
The truth is simpler: it's a sophisticated system. It tracks everything you've watched, liked, skipped, and even how long you hovered on a title.
This data feeds an algorithm that constantly learns your patterns, suggesting more of what's worked before, and less of the unknown.
Now you see the loop: the TV doesn't guess, it predicts. Knowing this, you can choose to break free from your own viewing history.
